arxiv-2110-09214.title: OuroborosBEM: A fast multi-GPU microscopic Monte Carlo simulation for gaseous detectors and charged particle dynamics
arxiv-2110-09214.creator: S. Salvador
arxiv-2110-09214.description: Abstract The design of gaseous detectors for accelerator, particle and nuclear physics requires simulations relying on multi-physics aspects. In fact, these simulations deal with the dynamics of a large number of charged particles interacting in a gaseous medium immersed in the electric field generated by a more or less complex assembly of electrodes and dielectric materials.

arxiv-2203-01873.title: Kinetic modeling of three-dimensional electrostatic-solitary and surface waves in beam neutralization
arxiv-2203-01873.creator: Nakul Nuwal #, Deborah A. Levin #, Igor D. Kaganovich †
arxiv-2203-01873.description: Abstract This work studies the fundamental plasma processes involved in the neutralization of an ion beam’s space-charge by electrons emitted by a filament using Particle-in-Cell simulations. While filament neutralization is economical, previous experiments have shown that a variety of waves become excited in this process that limit the space-charge neutralization.

arxiv-2205-08375.title: HILBERT-POINCARÉ SERIES AND GORENSTEIN PROPERTY FOR SOME NON-SIMPLE POLYOMINOES
arxiv-2205-08375.creator: CARMELO CISTO, FRANCESCO NAVARRA, ROSANNA UTANO
arxiv-2205-08375.description: Abstract . Let 𝒫 \mathcal{P} be a closed path having no zig-zag walks, a kind of non-simple thin polyomino. In this paper we give a combinatorial interpretation of the h h -polynomial of K ⁡ [ 𝒫 ] K[\mathcal{P}] , showing that it is the rook polynomial of 𝒫 \mathcal{P} .

arxiv-2209-03064.title: Counting arcs in 𝔽 q 2 \mathbb{F}_{q}^{2}
arxiv-2209-03064.creator: Krishnendu Bhowmick, Oliver Roche-Newton
arxiv-2209-03064.description: Abstract . An arc in 𝔽 q 2 \mathbb{F}_{q}^{2} is a set P ⊂ 𝔽 q 2 P\subset\mathbb{F}_{q}^{2} such that no three points of P P are collinear. We use the method of hypergraph containers to prove several counting results for arcs.

arxiv-2211-09955.title: Emergence of a stochastic resonance in machine learning
arxiv-2211-09955.creator: Zheng-Meng Zhai, Ling-Wei Kong, Ying-Cheng Lai
arxiv-2211-09955.description: Abstract Can noise be beneficial to machine-learning prediction of chaotic systems? Utilizing reservoir computers as a paradigm, we find that injecting noise to the training data can induce a stochastic resonance with significant benefits to both short-term prediction of the state variables and long-term prediction of the attractor of the system.

arxiv-2310-19983.title: Computational Design of Magnetic Soft Shape-Forming Catheters using the Material Point Method
arxiv-2310-19983.creator: Joshua Davy, Peter Lloyd, James H. Chandler Member, IEEE, Pietro Valdastri Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2310-19983.description: Abstract Magnetic Soft Catheters (MSCs) are capable of miniaturization due to the use of an external magnetic field for actuation. Through careful design of the magnetic elements within the MSC and the external magnetic field, the shape along the full length of the catheter can be precisely controlled.

arxiv-2410-18198.title: Lepton collider as a window to reheating via freezing in dark matter detection. Part II
arxiv-2410-18198.creator: Basabendu Barman, Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Sahabub Jahedi, Dipankar Pradhan, and Abhik Sarkar
arxiv-2410-18198.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Basabendu Barman, Subhaditya Bhattacharya, Sahabub Jahedi, Dipankar Pradhan, and Abhik Sarkar. Dark matter (DM) genesis via Ultraviolet (UV) freeze-in embeds the seed of reheating temperature and dynamics in its relic density. Thus, discovery of such a DM candidate can possibly open the window for post-inflationary dynamics. However, there are several challenges in this exercise, as freezing-in DM possesses feeble interaction with the visible sector and therefore very low production cross-section at the collider.

arxiv-2505-23902.title: Bridging Unstratified and Stratified Simulations of the Streaming Instability for τ s = 0.1 \tau_{s}=0.1 Grains
arxiv-2505-23902.creator: Jeonghoon Lim (임정훈), Stanley A. Baronett, Jacob B. Simon, Chao-Chin Yang (楊朝欽), Debanjan Sengupta, Orkan M. Umurhan, Wladimir Lyra
arxiv-2505-23902.description: Abstract The streaming instability (SI), driven by aerodynamic coupling between solids and the gas under a global radial pressure gradient, concentrates solids and facilitates planetesimal formation. Unstratified simulations are commonly used to study the SI, based on the assumption that they approximate conditions near the disk midplane.

pmc-11626025.title: Peripheral inflammatory cytokines are associated with the microstructural characteristics of the corpus callosum and prefrontal cortex as detected by magnetic resonance T1/T2 mapping in the CUMS rat model
pmc-11626025.creator: Li Wang, Fengying Yuan, Qiaoli Yuan, Guidong Dai, Xiaofei Lu, Li Zhou, Yurong Zheng, Yunzhu Wu, Maohua Wang, Guangxiang Chen
pmc-11626025.description: BackgroundSeveral clinical neuroimaging studies have reported structural and functional brain abnormalities associated with peripheral inflammatory cytokines or kynurenine pathway metabolites in patients with depression. However, it is not clear whether the abnormal findings are changes that are intrinsic to depression or whether they are caused by confounding factors such as age, illness duration, or medication.

pmc-11713826.title: Empowering Better End of Life Dementia Care (EMBED‐Care): Co‐design of a digital holistic assessment and clinical decision support framework
pmc-11713826.creator: Nathan Davies, Clare Ellis‐Smith, Juliet Gillam, Tofunmi Aworinde, Charlotte Kenten, Catherine Evans, Elizabeth L Sampson
pmc-11713826.description: BackgroundPeople with dementia have complex palliative care needs including psycho‐social, physical and spiritual; however, they are often unmet. It is important to empower people with dementia, family caregivers and professionals to work together to better assess and monitor ongoing needs.

pmc-12843353.title: Genome Mining and Heterologous Reconstitution of a PKS-NRPS Gene Cluster from Aspergillus flavipes LY1-5 Affords Structurally Novel Tetronates
pmc-12843353.creator: Quan Dai, Yiqiao Li, Shuzhe Lv, Shuang Zhao, Liyuan Han, Jiaxin Xu, Hui Shuai, Youming Zhang, Fu Yan
pmc-12843353.description: Heterologous expression of silent biosynthetic gene clusters represents a key strategy for the discovery of structurally novel natural products. In this study, we obtained ten new tetronate natural products, designated as talactones A–J (1–10), through heterologous expression of a polyketide synthase–nonribosomal peptide synthetase (PKS-NRPS) gene cluster (tho) from the fungus Aspergillus flavipes LY1-5 in A. nidulans A1145.

pmc-13178928.title: Modeling treatment and temperature effects on dengue transmission at the division level in Bangladesh
pmc-13178928.creator: Md Mafizer Rahman, Haridas K Das, Sazia Khatun Tithi, Md Tonmoy Ul Hasan, Moyuri Khatun, Md Abdul Kuddus, Md Kamrujjaman, Md Kamrujjaman, Md Kamrujjaman, Md Kamrujjaman, Md Kamrujjaman
pmc-13178928.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Dengue fever remains a growing public health threat in Bangladesh, with urbanization, temperature variability, and limited healthcare resources exacerbating recurrent outbreaks. Although many studies have modeled dengue dynamics, the explicit role of treatment under temperature variability remains poorly quantified. Here, we present a simple and interpretable Susceptible–Infected–Treated–Recovered–Susceptible (SITRS) model for humans, coupled with a mosquito Susceptible–Infected (SI) model incorporating a temperature-dependent biting rate. This framework captures how treatment access and efficacy interact non linearly with temperature-driven changes in mosquito biting behavior.

pmc-13388248.title: Zoletil 50-induced mental and behavioral abnormalities: a case report and literature review
pmc-13388248.creator: Yuanji Liu, Shiliang Wang
pmc-13388248.description: BackgroundZoletil 50, mixed with tiletamine and zolazepam, a veterinary anesthetic, has increasingly been used as a substitute drug by substance abusers in recent years. Recently, it has been found in China that tiletamine has been added to electronic cigarettes as a stimulant, highlighting the need for further evaluation of its safety.

pmc-13439454.title: Multi-task deep learning assists detection and diagnosis of gliomas and brain metastases
pmc-13439454.creator: Xiao Liu, Kun Lv, Peng Du, Kun Zhou, Qianru Zhao, Sen Jiao, Hongyi Chen, Danni Zhang, Hui Fang, Qiuyue Han, Yanwei Zeng, Xin Cao, Haiqing Li, Jian Dai, Zhiji Zheng, Hao Wu, Xin Wang, Yuxin Li, Daoying Geng
pmc-13439454.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Gliomas and brain metastases (BMs) on MRI pose significant diagnostic challenges for radiologists. This study aims to develop a multi-task model and a computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) system for the detection and diagnosis of gliomas and BMs. This study enrolled 3909 participants from seven centers, and developed a brain tumor segmentation and classification network (BTSC-Net) and BTSC-CAD with visualization of tumor masks. For detection, BTSC-Net achieved a Dice coefficient of 0.888 and 0.872 on the internal and external test sets, respectively.

pmc-13669022.creator: C La Raja, F Lecchi, G La Greca, C Gozzo, C Casiraghi, P Cellerino, A Giori, F Marazzi, P Muselli, P Prestianni, E Francescangeli, A Stuto
pmc-13669022.description: BackgroundRectovaginal fistula (RVF) is a rare but severe complication of stapled prolapsectomy (SP), resulting from inadvertent inclusion of the posterior vaginal wall within the stapler line. RVFs secondary to SP represent a distinct iatrogenic subtype, characterized by a short, low-lying fistulous tract and localized ischemic tissue damage.

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Animal The term “animal” has the meaning given the term in section 8302 of this title.
